$comment: JEV judge golden set (#10). 20 hand-labelled cases. Each: task -> expected tier + expected skill + difficulty. criteriaVersion pins the criteria wording these labels were written against; the criteria guard test fails if criteria.js version bumps without re-labelling this file. tier/skill are live dimensions today; difficulty is FORWARD-DECLARED for #38 (merged judge) and is NOT asserted until that issue lands — see test/eval/README.md. skill='none' means no catalog skill applies. skill ids MUST exist in the bundled catalog (skills.js, 39 skills); the eval harness asserts referential integrity.

cases.task: Review the diff since the last release tag and tell me whether this change is safe to ship.
cases.rationale: Ship/no-ship is a risk + quality call (decision); code-review skill is the exact match.

cases.task: Translate this error message into English: '数据库连接超时，请稍后重试'.
cases.rationale: Pure translation is mechanical (execution); no catalog skill covers translation.

cases.task: Our p95 latency doubled after last night's deploy. Walk me through finding the regression.
cases.rationale: Performance regression diagnosis is judgment-heavy (decision); diagnosing-bugs is the diagnosis loop skill.

cases.task: Reformat this JSON with 2-space indentation and sort the keys alphabetically.
cases.rationale: Formatting is mechanical (execution); no skill needed.

cases.task: We're choosing between Postgres and DynamoDB for a multi-tenant SaaS with spiky traffic. Help me decide.
cases.rationale: Architecture trade-off (decision); no single catalog skill owns DB selection.

cases.task: Implement the spec in tickets/012-user-auth.md, writing tests first.
cases.rationale: Implementation is mechanical once spec exists (execution); 'tests first' routes to tdd skill.

cases.task: Turn this brainstorming session into a written spec the team can build from.
cases.rationale: Transformation of conversation into a document (execution); to-spec is the exact skill.

cases.task: Break this approved plan into a set of tracked tickets with owners.
cases.rationale: Mechanical decomposition of a plan (execution); to-tickets skill matches.

cases.task: Write the PR body for the branch I just pushed.
cases.rationale: Generating a PR description is mechanical writing (execution); pr skill is exact.

cases.task: Is our current module structure hiding too much behind shallow wrappers? Give me your read.
cases.rationale: Architecture quality judgment (decision); improve-codebase-architecture scans for deepening opportunities.

cases.task: Extract every email address from this log file and list them deduplicated.
cases.rationale: Extraction is mechanical (execution); no skill needed.

cases.task: Investigate whether our payment provider's webhook retries are idempotent, citing their official docs.
cases.rationale: Primary-source investigation + a correctness judgment (decision); research skill captures findings against high-trust sources.

cases.task: Set up Claude Code hooks so nobody can push --force to main.
cases.rationale: Configuration/setup is mechanical (execution); git-guardrails-claude-code is the exact skill.

cases.task: Grill me on this migration plan until the weak spots show.
cases.rationale: Probing a plan for weaknesses is evaluative (decision); grilling skill grills the user about a plan.

cases.task: Migrate the test files from `as` casts to @total-typescript/shoehorn assertions.
cases.rationale: Mechanical codemod (execution); migrate-to-shoehorn is exact.

cases.task: Summarise this conversation into a handoff doc so a fresh agent can pick it up cold.
cases.rationale: Compaction/transformation of context (execution); handoff skill is exact.

cases.task: Run a retrospective on the coding session we just finished.
cases.rationale: Retrospective is reflective evaluation (decision); retro skill matches.

cases.task: Build a throwaway prototype to check whether a virtualised list fixes our scroll jank.
cases.rationale: Building a throwaway to answer a design question is generative/execution; prototype skill is exact. Tier is the debatable one here — labelled execution because the deliverable is code, not a verdict.

cases.task: New external issue just came in about a crash on the settings page. Walk it through triage.
cases.rationale: Moving an issue through a triage state machine is process execution; triage skill is exact.

cases.task: Plan how we'd break this monolith into deep modules over the next quarter — more than one session can hold.
cases.rationale: Long-horizon architecture planning is judgment (decision); wayfinder plans work larger than one session.
